title: Shared board step 1: serve one workspace to several people, each seeing only their projects
notes: Design: board spec, section Shared mode, step 1. Listen on loopback, trust one identity header from the proxy, filter in workspace_cards before the payload is built.
done_when: A request with an identity header of a listed person returns only the cards of that person's projects, in the page and the JSON; an unknown or missing identity gets 403; a test proves another person's task text is absent from the payload
